request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, ambient pads, gentle and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Who will rise up against the wicked
Who will stand with me against evildoers
If the Lord had not been my help
I would dwell in the land of silence

[Chorus]
When my foot was slipping
Your steadfast love held me up
When anxious thoughts filled my heart
Your consolations brought joy to my soul

[Verse]
Can a throne of destruction ally with you
One that frames injustice into law
They band together against the righteous
And condemn the innocent blood

[Chorus]
When my foot was slipping
Your steadfast love held me up
When anxious thoughts filled my heart
Your consolations brought joy to my soul

[Bridge]
But the Lord has become my stronghold
And my God the rock of my refuge

[Outro]
Your comfort gladdens my soul
Your love holds me up
